results.content: Bar chart shows 54% of North Carolinians disapprove of President Donald Trump’s job performance, 36% approve and 10% are unsure.President Trump continues to have low approval ratings among North Carolinians, with 54% of poll respondents disapproving of the job he is doing as president and 36% approving – an 18% gap. Ten percent were unsure about the president’s job performance. In comparison, in the March 2026 Elon University Poll, Trump had a 55% disapproval rating and a 35% approval rating –
